description:
AppCloud
It offers the"Aura Out-Of-the-Box Experience" (OOBE)
It is some kind of post-install recommended apps setup from the carrier. Asks for your age and gender and then recommends you to install popular apps.
Developed by IronSource, an Israeli advertising company (now owned by the American company Unity).
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IronSource
https://aura.ironsrc.com/tools/drive-app-downloads/
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2010.10088.pdf
Has way too many permissions.
See https://github.com/0x192/universal-android-debloater/issues/278
https://docs.samsungknox.com/admin/knox-platform-for-enterprise/knox-service-plugin/kbas/kba-954-unable-to-access-home-screen/
